trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَحْتَجَبْتُ بِنُوْرِ وَجْهِ اللهِ الْقَدِيْمِ الْكَامِلِ وَتَحَصَّنْتُ بِحِصْنِ اللهِ الْقَوِيِّ الشَّامِلِ وَرَمَيْتُ مَنْ بَغَى عَلَيَّ بِسَهْمِ اللهِ وَسَيْفِهِ الْقَاتِلِ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا غَالِبًا عَلٰى اَمْرِهٖ وَيَا قَائِمًا فَوْقَ خَلْقِهٖ وَيَا حَائِلًا بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهٖ حُلْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَنَزْغِهٖ۔

trans.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the household of Muhammad, I seek covering protection by the light of Allah, The Eternal, The Perfect And I seek to be entrenched by the haven of Allah, The Powerful, The Flawless I strike the (enemy) who attacks me by the arrow of Allah and His lethal sword O Allah, O One whose Will prevails, and O One who overpowers His creation.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: وَبَيْنَ مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لِيْ بِهٖ مِنْ اَحَدٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِكَ كُفَّ عَنِّيْ اَلْسِنَتَهُمْ وَاغْلُلْ اَيْدِيَهُمْ وَاَرْجُلَهُمْ وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا مِّنْ نُوْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَحِجَابًا مِّنْ قُدْرَتِكَ وَجُنْدًا مِّنْ سُلْطَانِكَ اِنَّكَ حَيٌّ قَادِرُ۔

trans.en: And O One who stands between the human and his heart, create a barrier between me and the enemy (shaitan) and his plots, and create a barrier between me and anyone of your creation which causes me distress beyond my capability, protect me from the sayings of their tongues, and tie up their hands and legs and create an occlusion between me and them by the Light of your Grandeur and a covering (hijab) by your Power and a protecting army from your Kingdom, verily you are Ever-Living, and The One with authority.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْشُ عَنِّيْ اَبْصَارَ النَّاظِرِيْنَ حَتّٰى اَرُدَّ الْمَوَارِدَ وَ اغْشُ عَنِّيْ اَبْصَارَ النُّوْرِ وَاَبْصَارَ الظُّلْمَةِ حَتّٰى لَا اُبَالِيَ عَنْ اَبْصَارِهِمْ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهٖ يَذْهَبُ بِالْاَبْصَارِ يُقَلِّبُ اللهُ اللَّيْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِاُوْلِي الْاَبْصَارِ۔

trans.en: O Allah, hide me from sight of the onlookers until I reach my desired destiny, and from the eyesight of the light and darkness so that I may not give any relevance to their vision. The flash of its lightning almost takes away the eyesight. Allah alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.

arabic.text: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ كٓهٰيٰٓعٓصٓ۔ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ حٰمٓ عٓسٓقٓ كَمَاءٍ اَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهٖ نَبَاتُ الْاَرْضِ فَاَصْبَحَ هَشِيْمًا تَذْرُوْهُ الرِّيَاحُ هُوَ اللهُ الَّذِيْ۔

trans.en: Bismillah Hir-Rahma Nir-Raheem Kaaf, Ha, Yaa, Aiyn, Saad. Bismillah Hir-Rahma Nir-Raheem. Ha, Meem, Aiyn, Seen, Qaaf. Its being is like the rain, which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and then it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds.

arabic.text: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ الرَّحِيْمُ يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ اِذِ الْقُلُوْبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِيْنَ مَا لِلظَّالِمِيْنَ مِنْ حَمِيْمٍ وَّلَا شَفِيْعٍ يُطَاعُ عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا اَحْضَرَتْ فَلَا اُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ۔

trans.en: There is no God but Allah, Knower of the unseen and witnessed, He is The Entirely Compassionate, The Especially Merciful. The approaching day, when hearts are at the throats, filled with (distress). For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor (who is) obeyed. A soul will [then] know what it has brought (with it).

arabic.text: وَاللَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ وَالْقُرْآنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ بَلِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِيْ عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ وَعَمِيَتِ الْاَبْصَارُ وَكَلَّتِ الْاَلْسُنُ۔

trans.en: So, I swear by the retreating stars. Those that run (their courses) and disappear. And by the night as it closes in- and by the dawn when it breathes. Sad. By the Quran containing reminder... but those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension. The faces have become astonished, the face have become astonished, the faces have become astonished, the eyes have become blinded, and the tongues have become tied.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَهُمْ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِمْ وَشَرَّهُمْ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيْهِمْ وَخَاتَمَ سُلَيْمَانَ بَيْنَ اَكْتَافِهِمْ فَسَيَكْفِيْكَهُمُ اللهُ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهٖ اَجْمَعِيْنَ۔

trans.en: O Allah, reveal their goodness between their eyes and keep their evil below their feet and allow the ring of Sulaiman to be between their shoulders for surely Allah will be sufficient for them and He is The All-Hearing, All-Knowing, and send blessings upon Muhammad and the holy progeny of Muhammad.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
